title: Myth flip — the $39 at-home hormone test
caption:
Myth: one hormone test tells you you're in perimenopause. It can't — FSH swings week to week. Cycle-length change is what stages it (STRAW+10, 2012). Log the gaps, bring them in.
Which myth next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#perimenopause #menopause #womenshealth #cycletracking #midlifewomen

scenes.text: "One test will tell me if this is *perimenopause*." It won't — hormones swing weekly.
Priya is 46, works remote with two teens, and her period just skipped 40 days.
phrases: Priya knew something had actually changed.

scenes.text: Doctors stage perimenopause by *cycle change*, not bloodwork — the diagnosis is clinical (ACOG).
phrases: A blood draw catches one morning.
Her hormones swing all month long.
So the pattern is the evidence:
A 7+ day gap between cycles counts (STRAW+10, 2012).

scenes.text: She starts a note called *cycle + 2 symptoms* and writes the first day of every period.
phrases: Log day 1 of each period in your notes.
Add your two worst symptoms that week.
Ask about CBT for hot flashes — it's recommended.
And walk 30 minutes, five days a week (WHO).
